editionLabel: Helvetiq English rulebook, cooperative base game
firstPlayerRule: In the cooperative game, the player who last spotted a dolphin starts.
clarifications: Play then continues clockwise. The separate competitive version has everyone act simultaneously and does not use this starting-player instruction.

sources.title: Fish 'n' Flip — English rules
sources.location: Cooperative setup and Turn overview; Competitive version

internalEvidence: Publisher-hosted 16-page English booklet. PDF page 3 assigns the start to the last dolphin spotter; page 4 confirms clockwise turns; page 12 describes simultaneous play in the separate competitive version. uncertainty: The booklet does not provide a tie-break or a method when nobody has spotted a dolphin.
